name: frontend-quality
description: Build accessible, responsive, bilingual customer/admin interfaces.
---

# Frontend Quality

1. Inspect the existing framework and conventions before editing.
2. Confirm Arabic RTL and English LTR behavior at page and component level.
3. Implement loading, empty, success, validation, and error states.
4. Use semantic HTML, keyboard support, visible focus, and accessible labels.
5. Avoid hard-coded clinical/product data and secrets.
6. Add component or browser tests for critical interactions.
7. Verify mobile layouts and report browsers/devices actually checked.
